rows.translation_en: Let us begin with this move.
rows.context: Hiruko's battle remarks: initially courteous, increasingly playful and desperate as combat progresses. The enemy addresses the clan party. Adjacent rows and all battle remarks examined.

rows.translation_en:
You will not be saying,
"I could have won at full strength."
rows.context: Hiruko's battle remarks: initially courteous, increasingly playful and desperate as combat progresses. The enemy addresses the clan party. Adjacent rows and all battle remarks examined.
Hiruko's battle remarks: initially courteous, increasingly playful and desperate as combat progresses. The enemy addresses the clan party. Adjacent rows and all battle remarks examined.

rows.translation_en:
A small token of my goodwill.
Please accept it.
rows.context: Hiruko's battle remarks: initially courteous, increasingly playful and desperate as combat progresses. The enemy addresses the clan party. Adjacent rows and all battle remarks examined.

rows.translation_en:
Now, let us see
what you can do.
rows.context: Hiruko's battle remarks: initially courteous, increasingly playful and desperate as combat progresses. The enemy addresses the clan party. Adjacent rows and all battle remarks examined.

rows.translation_en: I shall target whoever has more HP.
rows.context: Hiruko's battle remarks: initially courteous, increasingly playful and desperate as combat progresses. The enemy addresses the clan party. Adjacent rows and all battle remarks examined.

rows.translation_en:
Kagero, Ishizaru, Bonpin...
Use whatever you please.
rows.context: Hiruko's battle remarks: initially courteous, increasingly playful and desperate as combat progresses. The enemy addresses the clan party. Adjacent rows and all battle remarks examined.

rows.translation_en:
Then allow me
to begin my attack.
rows.context: Hiruko's battle remarks: initially courteous, increasingly playful and desperate as combat progresses. The enemy addresses the clan party. Adjacent rows and all battle remarks examined.

rows.translation_en:
Ow, ow...
That one certainly hurt.
rows.context: Hiruko's battle remarks: initially courteous, increasingly playful and desperate as combat progresses. The enemy addresses the clan party. Adjacent rows and all battle remarks examined.

rows.translation_en:
I now have a fair idea
of your strength.
rows.context: Hiruko's battle remarks: initially courteous, increasingly playful and desperate as combat progresses. The enemy addresses the clan party. Adjacent rows and all battle remarks examined.

rows.translation_en:
Hmm...
Just as the rumors said.
rows.context: Hiruko's battle remarks: initially courteous, increasingly playful and desperate as combat progresses. The enemy addresses the clan party. Adjacent rows and all battle remarks examined.

rows.translation_en:
This is my way of atoning.
You need not hold back at all.
rows.context: Hiruko's battle remarks: initially courteous, increasingly playful and desperate as combat progresses. The enemy addresses the clan party. Adjacent rows and all battle remarks examined.

rows.translation_en:
Rest assured, I will not use
Netaro, Tokoyomi, or Hinashi.
rows.context: Hiruko's battle remarks: initially courteous, increasingly playful and desperate as combat progresses. The enemy addresses the clan party. Adjacent rows and all battle remarks examined.

rows.translation_en:
Perhaps it is time
to try some attack spells.
rows.context: Hiruko's battle remarks: initially courteous, increasingly playful and desperate as combat progresses. The enemy addresses the clan party. Adjacent rows and all battle remarks examined.

rows.translation_en: I shall change my tactics a little.
rows.context: Hiruko's battle remarks: initially courteous, increasingly playful and desperate as combat progresses. The enemy addresses the clan party. Adjacent rows and all battle remarks examined.

rows.translation_en: Shall we make things a little flashier?
rows.context: Hiruko's battle remarks: initially courteous, increasingly playful and desperate as combat progresses. The enemy addresses the clan party. Adjacent rows and all battle remarks examined.

rows.translation_en:
How wonderful!!
You are far stronger than I imagined.
rows.context: Hiruko's battle remarks: initially courteous, increasingly playful and desperate as combat progresses. The enemy addresses the clan party. Adjacent rows and all battle remarks examined.

rows.translation_en: Just what I would expect of the %@ clan.
rows.context: Hiruko's battle remarks: initially courteous, increasingly playful and desperate as combat progresses. The enemy addresses the clan party. Adjacent rows and all battle remarks examined.

rows.translation_en:
Will those tactics really
be enough to defeat me?
rows.context: Hiruko's battle remarks: initially courteous, increasingly playful and desperate as combat progresses. The enemy addresses the clan party. Adjacent rows and all battle remarks examined.

rows.translation_en:
While I can feel pain,
it is as though I am human again.
rows.context: Hiruko's battle remarks: initially courteous, increasingly playful and desperate as combat progresses. The enemy addresses the clan party. Adjacent rows and all battle remarks examined.
review_notes: Hiruko compares feeling pain with being human again; no claim of an actual transformation is added.

rows.translation_en:
It seems someone
is not content merely to watch...
rows.context: Hiruko's battle remarks: initially courteous, increasingly playful and desperate as combat progresses. The enemy addresses the clan party. Adjacent rows and all battle remarks examined.
review_notes: Unspecified observers are addressed without inferred gender.

rows.translation_en: I shall take a short rest.
rows.context: Hiruko's battle remarks: initially courteous, increasingly playful and desperate as combat progresses. The enemy addresses the clan party. Adjacent rows and all battle remarks examined.
Hiruko's battle remarks: initially courteous, increasingly playful and desperate as combat progresses. The enemy addresses the clan party. Adjacent rows and all battle remarks examined.

rows.translation_en:
Every last one of the gods
has far too much time to spare...
rows.context: Hiruko's battle remarks: initially courteous, increasingly playful and desperate as combat progresses. The enemy addresses the clan party. Adjacent rows and all battle remarks examined.

rows.translation_en:
I have warmed up now.
Let us begin in earnest!!
rows.context: Hiruko's battle remarks: initially courteous, increasingly playful and desperate as combat progresses. The enemy addresses the clan party. Adjacent rows and all battle remarks examined.

rows.translation_en:
Hee hee...
Now I am enjoying myself!!
rows.context: Hiruko's battle remarks: initially courteous, increasingly playful and desperate as combat progresses. The enemy addresses the clan party. Adjacent rows and all battle remarks examined.

rows.translation_en:
Come to think of it,
my name is Taishoten, after all.
rows.context: Hiruko's battle remarks: initially courteous, increasingly playful and desperate as combat progresses. The enemy addresses the clan party. Adjacent rows and all battle remarks examined.

rows.translation_en:
Turn all your hatred, anger,
and sorrow into strength.
rows.context: Hiruko's battle remarks: initially courteous, increasingly playful and desperate as combat progresses. The enemy addresses the clan party. Adjacent rows and all battle remarks examined.

rows.translation_en:
Let's finish this
with a bang!!
rows.context: Hiruko's battle remarks: initially courteous, increasingly playful and desperate as combat progresses. The enemy addresses the clan party. Adjacent rows and all battle remarks examined.

rows.translation_en:
Shall I struggle
just a little longer?
rows.context: Hiruko's battle remarks: initially courteous, increasingly playful and desperate as combat progresses. The enemy addresses the clan party. Adjacent rows and all battle remarks examined.

rows.translation_en:
From here on,
I'm throwing caution to the wind!
rows.context: Hiruko's battle remarks: initially courteous, increasingly playful and desperate as combat progresses. The enemy addresses the clan party. Adjacent rows and all battle remarks examined.

rows.translation_en:
Fair and square...?
What's that? Is it tasty?
rows.context: Hiruko's battle remarks: initially courteous, increasingly playful and desperate as combat progresses. The enemy addresses the clan party. Adjacent rows and all battle remarks examined.
review_notes: The dismissive idiom is retained as a spoken joke rather than a literal claim about food.

rows.translation_en: I'm right here in front of you!!
rows.context: Hiruko's battle remarks: initially courteous, increasingly playful and desperate as combat progresses. The enemy addresses the clan party. Adjacent rows and all battle remarks examined.

rows.translation_en: So, who wants to die first?
rows.context: Kitsuto's battle taunts to the clan, followed by appeals to his mother. Male speaker confirmed by glossary; the clan party remains ungendered. All adjacent battle remarks examined.

rows.translation_en:
Don't worry.
I'll put you out of your misery soon.
rows.context: Kitsuto's battle taunts to the clan, followed by appeals to his mother. Male speaker confirmed by glossary; the clan party remains ungendered. All adjacent battle remarks examined.

rows.translation_en:
Aren't you fighting the wrong person?
Oh well. Suit yourselves.
rows.context: Kitsuto's battle taunts to the clan, followed by appeals to his mother. Male speaker confirmed by glossary; the clan party remains ungendered. All adjacent battle remarks examined.

rows.translation_en:
You'd better take our game seriously...
or I'll kill you!!
rows.context: Kitsuto's battle taunts to the clan, followed by appeals to his mother. Male speaker confirmed by glossary; the clan party remains ungendered. All adjacent battle remarks examined.

rows.translation_en:
Maybe you lot
can actually beat me~♪
rows.context: Kitsuto's battle taunts to the clan, followed by appeals to his mother. Male speaker confirmed by glossary; the clan party remains ungendered. All adjacent battle remarks examined.

rows.translation_en:
Kill me and the curse goes away...
Who told you that?
rows.context: Kitsuto's battle taunts to the clan, followed by appeals to his mother. Male speaker confirmed by glossary; the clan party remains ungendered. All adjacent battle remarks examined.

rows.translation_en:
Oh, right. That pitiful man...
Genta, was it?
rows.context: Kitsuto's battle taunts to the clan, followed by appeals to his mother. Male speaker confirmed by glossary; the clan party remains ungendered. All adjacent battle remarks examined.

rows.translation_en:
If I had wings,
I'd go raise hell in heaven.
rows.context: Kitsuto's battle taunts to the clan, followed by appeals to his mother. Male speaker confirmed by glossary; the clan party remains ungendered. All adjacent battle remarks examined.

rows.translation_en:
Why is fighting to the death
so much fun?
rows.context: Kitsuto's battle taunts to the clan, followed by appeals to his mother. Male speaker confirmed by glossary; the clan party remains ungendered. All adjacent battle remarks examined.

rows.translation_en:
You and I are all just
dancing to my sister's tune.
rows.context: Kitsuto's battle taunts to the clan, followed by appeals to his mother. Male speaker confirmed by glossary; the clan party remains ungendered. All adjacent battle remarks examined.
Kitsuto's battle taunts to the clan, followed by appeals to his mother. Male speaker confirmed by glossary; the clan party remains ungendered. All adjacent battle remarks examined.

Mother...
